args.meaning: Optional arguments passed by the front door to the nap parser; accepts --dry-run and --user-id with a value.

dry-run.meaning: Front-door dry-run request, forwarded as --dry-run when true.

dry_run.meaning: Native nap payload flag. True or a true front-door flag selects a read-only pass.

user_id.meaning: Memory scope override; nonblank after trimming. If omitted, retain any argv override; explicit null selects the owning account’s configured scope.

folded.meaning: Count marked or proposed as duplicates.

stale.meaning: Count marked or proposed as contradicted.

gist.meaning: Count of gists written or proposed.

unresolved.meaning: Count of unresolved judgments; absent when no pass reply was obtained.

decision_failures.meaning: Model-decision parse or shape failure counts by reason.

dry_run.meaning: Whether the child ran in dry mode; present in a completed child result.

marks.meaning: Child fold/stale outcomes, including proposals in a dry run.

older_id.meaning: Older memory id as held by the store.

gists.meaning: Gist proposals returned only by a dry child pass.

sources.meaning: Source excerpts for up to the first three proposals.

errorType.meaning: Exception class from a failed child pass.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class if dispatch escapes to the front door.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Explicit false on the parser’s argument refusal; not a success count.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Refusals from the parser, dispatcher or child. A completed successful pass has no signal.
